name: Claude Code
author: Yang Li
description: Deployment baseline that receives the capabilities introduced up to the current stage. Its prompt and agent program are not optimized between stages.
settings: All capabilities introduced through the selected stage
3 runs for each evaluated combination of stream, system stage, and task group; each task is attempted once per run
Not reported; held-out evaluation usage excludes training, memory building and optimization
notes: Some EOG token-usage measurements come from 1 additional repetition run specifically to measure usage. Accuracy uses the original 3 evaluation repetitions. Missing token counts mean the reported usage may understate total cost.

prerequisites: Obtain the original Claude Code runner and its locked dependencies/container image from the experiment authors. The registered folder contains exported results, not executable runner source.
Obtain the original Vertex provider/model endpoint configuration and use your own credentials. Sonnet-4.6 is the reported display label; an immutable historical model identifier was not recovered.
Obtain the versioned dataset, stage capability bundles, verifier assets and archived task exclusions.
missing: No source-supported launch command exists in the supplied result-only export. Do not substitute the Codex launcher or invent Claude CLI flags.
Historical Claude Code version, exact model/Vertex region, prompts and launch overrides, ALE solver budget and concurrency are absent from the export.
EOG timeout records establish a 900-second cap; ALE limits are not established. Three accuracy repeats exist, but some usage measurements come from a separate one-run token sweep.

protocol.solver_model: Sonnet-4.6 (reported label; exact historical identifier unavailable)

reproduction.result_reconstruction: Included per-task scores and success flags reproduce all archived aggregates offline.
